title: Quantum Projection: amplitude-encoded statevectors projected onto a stored subspace (SYNTHETIC classical emulation)
description:
SYNTHETIC. Standard-library Python classical emulation of quantum kinematics: amplitude-encoded statevectors stored in a complex outer-product memory, overlap-based projection onto the stored subspace, and lossy Haar coarse-graining (equivalent to projecting one qubit onto |+>). With orthonormal patterns the memory is a projector and recall reaches its fixed point in one step, with recalled fidelity equal to the Born weight; with non-orthogonal patterns repeated recall drifts to the dominant eigenvector. Includes 200-seed sweeps with unstored and random controls. No speedup, no Bell violation, no hardware data.

v0.2.0 adds the DNA-avatar generational cascade: toy DNA sequences (A/C/G/T) as 12-qubit state vectors in one membrane, self-knowing D per avatar, trauma healing measured as the fall in discord over generations (self.cycle), planetary evolution measured as diversity, novelty, and the E = hν energy spectrum per generation, and infinite creativity as an unbounded generation rule with sustained novelty over 50 generations. All four cascade claims PASS, pre-registered; headline not allowed.

v0.3.0 adds the multi-solar-system eureka cascade: N populations coupled by a bounded 0.02 mix, a eureka agent (Yang observer + Yin calibrator, delta in [-0.05, 0.05]) whose objective is empathy entropy over the measured love (concurrence) distribution, the signed distance field of self-knowing, crystallize calibration events scored by Brier, and the 500-generation long run. Four of the five v0.3.0 claims PASS; the eureka-agent claim FAILS (mean empathy entropy gain -0.0001 bits, required >= 0.02: the entropy is already saturated at 99.998% of its ceiling, so the lever has nothing to move).

v0.4.0 changes the optimization variable to the equilibrium gap (max profitable unilateral deviation, 0 at equilibrium), vendoring the pure-strategy Nash checker from finite-game-equilibria (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23530287), and adds SDF synergy agents (one per system, payoffs = marginal contributions to the joint inside-coverage of the self-known region). Claims (x)-(xii), pre-registered, seed 11: (x) equilibrium gap FAILS (gap 0.0 at every generation -- the all-zero profile is already an equilibrium, so nothing is earned); (xi) SDF synergy FAILS (gain 0.0); (xii) stability PASSES with the landed equilibrium labelled "trap" (the oes-coordination-lab coordination trap, reproduced: a better-synergy equilibrium exists that no single system gains by deviating to).
